neighbours.label: verb stem split before its inflection (know|eth, detect|s, Launch|es)
fire: The antivirus program quietly detects and removes the threat.
He that walketh in the night knoweth not where he goes.
The city council Launches its new recycling plan today.
Our scanner automatically detects faulty parts on the line.
The old prophet speaketh of a coming flood.
The agency Launches a fresh campaign every spring.
This sensor detects motion even in total darkness.
And the shepherd knoweth each of his sheep by name.
quiet: The antivirus program quietly finds and removes the threat.
He who walks in the night does not see where he goes.
The city council starts its new recycling plan today.
Our scanner automatically finds faulty parts on the line.
The old prophet spoke of a coming flood.
The agency starts a fresh campaign every spring.
This sensor sees motion even in total darkness.
And the shepherd knows each of his sheep by name.

notes: card examples: verb stems whose suffix is a separate token; also German verb endings.
